definitionZh: 在 CSS 中, *safter 创建了一个伪元素, 即选定元素的最后一个子 。 常用于在内容属性的元素中添加化妆品内容. 默认是内在的。
sourceDefinition: In CSS, ::after creates a pseudo-element that is the last child of the selected element. It is often used to add cosmetic content to an element with the content property. It is inline by default.
